text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Wonder Acute is still going strong as she
heads
into the final stretch! But will she
be able to
maintain this pace?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Huff! Huff! Puff!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Hngh!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Huff! Huff! Puff!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I recognize this tempo... It's the same as
our
spirited massages.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's as if she's given herself a shot of
energy to
drive herself forward, allowing
her to keep up this
incredible pace
without missing a beat.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Graaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
It's Wonder Acute! Wonder Acute has
crossed the
finish line in first plaaace!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
What an incredible display of
consistency—of
imperturbable
steadfastness!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
With this race, she's proven that she's
going down
in the annals of dirt history!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff, puff...Acute...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
That was incredible... It's like you've
widened the
gap between us...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
That's right, but don't fret, dearie.
There's no
rush.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
As long as you keep chasing after me,
you'll keep
improving.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Because I'll always be up ahead, just out
of reach.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The smile she gives Tarumae is that of an

incredibly experienced teacher.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Well, Trainer. It seems the path ahead
stretches
on for quite a while yet.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Come, take a look.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
The dirt stretches on as far as you can
see. I'm
sure there are times when I'll get
excited and rush
myself to exhaustion.
But even if I do...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I won't stop. I'll get back up and keep
going, one
step at a time.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
No matter what comes my way, I'll get
through it,
reclaim my pace, and keep
moving forward the
same as ever.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I'll shine the way only an Umamusume
who does
that can. And I'll keep shining
just as bright—no,
even brighter—as time
goes on.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Yes. And I'd like to walk that road with
you by my
side, hand-in-hand.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
What do you say? Will you walk with
me? ...As far
as my legs will carry me?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
So many people have been watching
Wonder
Acute throughout her
career—not only fans.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I see... so even after all that time
building up their
energy field, the White
Tiger is still no match for
the Black
Tortoise...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Which means I don't stand even a slight
chance!
But starting next year, if I keep
at it little by
little...

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
So you've chosen Oi as your stage? Alas,
I'm
unable to watch in person.
However...

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Face your destiny as your heart directs,
and all
shall be well. You have nothing
to be ashamed of,
nor any reason to
look back.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Ah, meeting you was truly wondrous, but
now we
must part! But fear not, our
farewell will be just as
grand!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Now, go forth, Acute! Go forth as thou
art!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Um... Thank you for all the support,
everyone. I
only know how to run in my
own way and at my
own pace, but as
long as you're okay with that...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: I'll keep running for as long as I can.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I think that path will take me farther
than any
amount of rushing ahead.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
That's just who I am. Do you think you
can still
support me?

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Of course, Acute! I'll be cheering for
you!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
As long as you're happy, keep doing
what you're
doing!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, everyone. As long as I have
your
support...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I will not stop. I will not fall. No matter
what, I will
continue to be a presence in
dirt racing for years
to come.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
With this body, I will share the stories of
dirt
champions, past and present. So
please...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Keep coming back to hear what happens
next.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
That goes for next year, and the year
after that.
And so on and so forth, into
the future.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Together, we shall greet new challengers
and
continue this story for all eternity.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Well then, I'll see you all next year,
then! Have a
happy New Year!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Wonder Acute gives a passionate
goodbye to the
audience.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As they watch her go, the crowd and I
can tell
that Wonder Acute's story is far
from over.
